meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 生成的冗余代码清理干净,再用回归测试确保功能没被改坏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想清理留下的坏味道又怕改坏功能
copy.tagline_en: Clean up redundant AI-written code, then run regression tests to confirm nothing broke
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI often and want to remove the resulting smells without breaking things

howto.what: 它会先给改动文件写回归测试锁住现有行为,再按类别清理 AI 生成的代码异味(如冗余注释、过度防御、死代码、重复代码),然后跑 lint、类型检查和测试并做关键审查;验证不通过就回滚。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop 或去掉最近改动里的 AI 味时触发。默认范围是分支相对 main 的 diff,也可以由调用方传入指定文件列表。

say.text: 帮我清理这次分支改动里的 AI 味
say.note: 会先写回归测试锁定行为再动手

say.text: 对 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py 跑一遍 deslop
say.note: 清理范围就限这两个文件

say.text: 把改动里超过 250 行的文件拆成小模块
say.note: 会先给出拆分方案再执行

howto.what_en: Claude first writes regression tests to lock current behavior, then removes AI-generated slop from changed files by category, runs quality gates, and does a critical review. If verification fails it reverts or edits directly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff against main, or an explicit file list passed in.

say_en.text: Clean up the AI slop in this branch's changes
say_en.note: Writes regression tests first, then cleans

say_en.text: Run deslop on src/foo.py and src/bar.py
say_en.note: Scoped to those two files only

say_en.text: Split files over 250 lines in my changes into smaller modules
say_en.note: Presents a split plan before editing
